Package index

Setup

Check what each output needs, and install fonts and logos.

phw_setup_check()
Check what phwstyle needs on this computer
phw_install_fonts()
Install the Ubuntu font for your user account
phw_register_fonts()
Register the bundled Ubuntu fonts
phw_font()
PHW font family
phw_font_dependency()
HTML dependency that serves the Ubuntu web font
phw_download_logos()
Download the PHW logo
phw_has_logo()
Does phwstyle have a PHW logo to use?
phw_logo()
Path to a PHW logo file
phw_graphic()
Path to a PHW brand graphic

Colours and palettes

Brand colours, palettes, the default palette, and colour keys that keep each group the same colour across charts and reports.

phw_colours
Public Health Wales brand colours
phw_col()
Get PHW colours by name
phw_pal()
Get a vector of colours from a PHW palette
phw_pal_fun()
Palette functions for scales
phw_palettes
PHW palettes
phw_default_palette()
The default qualitative palette
show_phw_palettes()
Show PHW palettes
phw_colour_key()
Fixed colours for groups that stay the same across reports
phw_key() phw_keys() phw_key_set() phw_key_recolour() phw_key_reset() phw_key_file()
Manage colour keys

Accessibility

Switch every chart, table and widget to the colour-blind safe palette, check colours for contrast and colour blindness, and give groups a second cue besides colour.

phw_check_colours()
Check colours for colour-blind readers and contrast
phw_contrast()
Contrast ratio between two colours
phw_text_on()
Choose readable text colour for a background
phw_cvd()
Simulate colour vision deficiency
scale_shape_phw() scale_linetype_phw()
Shape and linetype scales for colour-blind readers

ggplot2 charts

Style every plot with use_phw_ggplot(), or one plot with theme_phw() and the PHW scales. Then add a second axis, a logo footer, or save at report size.

use_phw_ggplot()
Use PHW styling for every ggplot in the session
theme_phw()
PHW theme for ggplot2
theme_phw_map()
PHW map theme
scale_colour_phw_d() scale_fill_phw_d() scale_color_phw_d() scale_colour_phw_c() scale_fill_phw_c() scale_color_phw_c() scale_colour_phw_b() scale_fill_phw_b() scale_color_phw_b() scale_fill_phw_div() scale_colour_phw_div() scale_color_phw_div()
PHW colour and fill scales
phw_sec_axis()
Secondary axis for a second measure
phw_finalise()
Add the PHW footer (logo and source) to a ggplot
phw_save()
Save a PHW chart
phw_style_extensions()
Style geoms from ggplot2 extension packages

Multi-plot figures

Several charts in one figure with one title and source line.

phw_arrange()
Arrange several plots in one PHW-styled figure
phw_title_grob()
PHW title for gridExtra and cowplot layouts

Public health charts

Ready-made ggplots for surveillance and quality improvement.

phw_epicurve()
Epidemic curve
phw_pyramid()
Population pyramid
phw_funnel()
Funnel plot
phw_forest()
Forest plot
phw_spc()
Statistical process control (SPC) chart

Maps

Boundaries for every level of Welsh geography, and interactive maps.

phw_boundaries()
Boundaries of Welsh areas for maps
phw_boundary_levels()
Boundary levels available for Wales
phw_boundaries_cache()
Boundary cache folder
phw_map()
Choropleth maps for reports
phw_leaflet() phw_leaflet_polygons() phw_leaflet_palette()
Interactive maps with leaflet

Building tables

Build a table once from a data frame, then render it with any table package.

phw_summary_table()
Summary table of characteristics by group
phw_as_summary()
Turn a table you built into a summary table
phw_crosstab()
Cross-tabulation of counts
phw_rate_table()
Rates with confidence intervals by group
phw_poisson_ci()
Exact Poisson confidence interval for a count
phw_risk_table()
Attack rates and relative risks by exposure
phw_group_table()
Grouped table with nested row and column groups

flextable (Word, PDF, PowerPoint)

Render a data frame or a summary table as a styled flextable, colour cells by value or group, and add in-cell bars.

phw_flextable()
Make a PHW-styled flextable from a data frame
phw_flextable_theme()
Apply PHW styling to a flextable
use_phw_flextable()
Set PHW defaults for every new flextable
phw_flextable_heat()
Colour flextable cells by value
phw_flextable_bars()
Add in-cell bars to a flextable
phw_flextable_groups()
Colour flextable cells by group

gt and gtsummary

The same tables rendered with gt, and a theme for every gtsummary table.

phw_gt_theme() phw_gt()
PHW style for gt tables
use_phw_gtsummary()
PHW theme for gtsummary

Interactive HTML

phw_reactable_theme()

phw_plotly()

phw_plotly_colorscale()
